what: in-place velocity update: what survives a real workspace arrival in a real browser

notes: no selection-capable field in the panel; using number

reco.note: searchToDispatchMs starts at the SEARCH CLICK, before the main table read. responseMs is server AND network, never server time - server.serverDurationMs is the server half and server.canonicalRead splits it further. domWorkMs is SYNCHRONOUS DOM WORK ONLY and is NOT a paint. paintOpportunityMs is taken after two animation frames: it is an APPROXIMATION of the earliest moment the browser COULD have painted, never an observation that anything was shown - the page cannot see the operator screen, and no figure here may be quoted as a visible instant. It is bound to the request that scheduled it (timing.forSeq); null means no frame ran for THAT request, not that nothing rendered.

gap.note: readerCalls counts loadInventoryGap_ entries; networkReads counts calls that actually reached KM.DB.getInventoryReplenishmentGap. A reuse increments the first and not the second.

avg.title: Avg Sales/day: up to 30 normal sales days in the 90 completed days before 2026-10-18 (the recommendation calculation date). Gap and Suggested Qty are calculated as of 2026-11-01 - a different date, set by the gap calculation run.

scopes.countryAxisNote: The cross-site axis here is MARKETPLACE. A cross-COUNTRY switch was attempted in CP2X-R1 and the country select never offered a second country, so the country axis is covered by the offline suite instead; the marketplace component is part of the same scope key and is driven here for real.
